title: Day one with a capable stranger

switch-to-the-room.title: Switch to the room
switch-to-the-room.keywords: forget AI, Monday morning, new colleague, coffee in hand
switch-to-the-room.script: Forget AI for a moment. Imagine it is Monday morning, and a new colleague starts today. Take a second and picture them standing at your desk, coffee in hand, ready to go.

a-real-task.title: A real task
a-real-task.keywords: real task, real deadline, who this person is
a-real-task.script: And you have a real task for them. Not a lecture, not a case study. A real one, with a real deadline. Let me tell you who this person is, and what you need from them.
